Subject: Ops snapshot & CFO QBR prep — May KPI brief and next steps

Good morning team,

Attached is the May KPI dashboard we need to surface for the CFO QBR next week. High-level callouts from the dashboard (see attached May_kpi_dashboard.pdf):

- Latency: P50 increased from ~110ms (Apr) to ~120ms (May YTD); P95 skewed by several long tail requests to 780ms.
- Cost: average cost per 1M tokens moved from $120 to $135 — primary driver appears to be higher long-context model usage and a temporary fallback to non-quantized nodes during a rollout.
- Uptime: 99.98% (one brief 12-minute window on 05/02 attributed to a regional autoscaler misconfiguration).
- Usage: +28% MoM in active tokens; session length distribution shift (more >8k tokens sessions).

Immediate asks (please reply inline):
1) One-line hypothesis for cause for latency and cost uptick (owner)
2) Two concrete mitigation items we can commit to before the QBR (owners + ETA)
3) Any slides or numbers you want included for the CFO (I can assemble a single slide)

I'll compile responses and send a single-slide brief for CFO review by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks —
Marissa

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 9:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is the May KPI dashboard we need to surface for the CFO QBR next week.

Quick notes/hypotheses:
- Latency: correlated with the model-rollout on 05/01 where we pushed v2.3 to 40% traffic; we saw an uptick in average sequence length (more users enabling memory mode) which increases KV-cache churn.
- Cost: temporary fallback to non-quantized instances in eu-west during the rollout (fallback policy misrouted some traffic due to a kernel selector bug).
- Uptime blip: autoscaler misconfigured min-replicas caused a scale down during a burst; fixed via runtime policy rollback.

Proposed mitigations (can commit before QBR):
1) Immediate: roll back v2.3 to 20% and flip kernel selector guard (Logan) — ETA: 6 hours.
2) Short-term: enable conservative prefix caching for the affected routes to reduce token throughput by estimated 6–10% (Logan + Infra) — ETA: 48 hours.

I'll provide a short 2-bullet causal summary you can paste into the CFO slide.

- Logan
Principal SRE
Redwood Inference
